note: Recovery from a worker that failed without deciding anything. Only the model call is replaced; the orchestrator, the repository and the event writer are the ones a live incident uses, so these timeline entries are the entries a live incident produces. Retry used to match HTTP 429 only, so a routine Vertex 503 on the Commander produced no plan, and the run loop breaks on that. One busy data centre aborted a 42-container rescue.
